svg.title: 묵종: 삶의 흔적을 삼킨 검푸른 청동 대종
svg.desc: A Korean great bell whose sacred casting has been grievously distorted. Compressed, incomplete human impressions dissolve into the cast bronze rather than becoming attached figures. Two small traces of ordinary metal survive in the folds. Blackened oxidation, matte brass wear and broad cold modelling carry grief without blood or readable revelations. The original hollow mouth, east sound aperture, bearing ear and 200-unit descent remain unchanged.
